title: Joomla! Core - [20261147] - Core - Information disclosure in mail template SMTP OAuth2 handling in Joomla 6.2.0-6.2.0…
description: Joomla! Core - [20261147] - Core - Information disclosure in mail template SMTP OAuth2 handling in Joomla 6.2.0-6.2.0 - Mail templates with an own SMTP host could send the global SMTP OAuth2 token to a host chosen by a non super user.
